validators.name: AUTH_CONTEXT
validators.rule: ActorContext는 server authentication과 input scope/actor attribution 일치; object access project-safe

validators.name: REF_EXISTENCE
validators.rule: 모든 ref의 owner scope/id/revision/digest/media가 registry와 일치; missing/stale HOLD

validators.name: READINESS_COMPLETENESS
validators.rule: 8 readiness area가 중복 없이 모두 존재하고 mandatory conflict/missing 미해결 없음

validators.name: CONTRACT_BINDING
validators.rule: acceptance ID unique; mandatory verifier/evidence binding complete; protected constraints retained

validators.name: DESIGN_CAPABILITY
validators.rule: mode design은 design artifacts만 write하며 source implementation/deploy effects 없음

validators.name: GRAPH_ACYCLIC
validators.rule: unique node/work IDs; only existing depends_on; acyclic; stable topological order

validators.name: GRAPH_DATA_TYPES
validators.rule: consumes chooses exactly (from_node+output_name) or external_ref; named producer output exists, dominates consumer, type matches; names unique within node

validators.name: GRAPH_COVERAGE
validators.rule: criterion IDs exist; mandatory global acceptance covered; join semantics satisfy dependencies

validators.name: CONTRACT_GRAPH_REVISION
validators.rule: graph bound contract가 current frozen contract와 일치; changed semantics requires new revision

validators.name: PERMISSION_SUBSET
validators.rule: effective capability subset of requested/actor/policy/sandbox/qualified driver; deny precedence

validators.name: GRANT_VALIDITY
validators.rule: signature trust, issuer role, scope/digest/action/expiry/generation/max_use 모두 현재 유효

validators.name: FENCE_CURRENT
validators.rule: run/work/lease epoch+fence+expiry current; old worker may audit but cannot transition

validators.name: ROOT_BUDGET
validators.rule: atomic total reservations+actual/unknown estimates including native child within root ceiling

validators.name: EFFECT_IDEMPOTENCY
validators.rule: effect key와 payload digest one binding; unknown outcome requires reconciliation

validators.name: ARTIFACT_TRUST
validators.rule: actual bytes hash/media/size/time/environment/producer attestation valid; no forged pass

validators.name: VERDICT_COVERAGE
validators.rule: current artifact/contract/graph refs and trusted verdicts; every mandatory acceptance must PASS; optional authorized waiver recorded separately; protected invariant cannot be waived

validators.name: TIME_ORDER
validators.rule: UTC canonical times ordered; expiry after not_before; future/stale observations policy checked

validators.name: CONTEXT_CLOSURE
validators.rule: governing-set complete; mandatory fresh; source references and supersession checked

validators.name: PACK_RELEASE_TRUST
validators.rule: signatures, dependency acyclicity, compatible protocol, owned paths, driver qualified exact version

validators.name: EVAL_FREEZE
validators.rule: baseline/candidate/corpus/verifier/env frozen; holdout access isolated; report no drift/unknown hiding

validators.name: PROMOTION_AUTHORITY
validators.rule: passed eligible eval/canary, no safety failure, exact grant and expected active pointer

validators.name: MIGRATION_PREFLIGHT
validators.rule: expected old digests/owner/live refs/backup/approval/tests and rollback compatibility valid

validators.name: EVENT_OWNERSHIP
validators.rule: worker events allowlisted; server-only event forgery rejected; aggregate seq server-generated

validators.name: CANONICAL_HASH
validators.rule: JCS golden conformance incl Unicode/numbers; no hash self-cycle/signature inclusion ambiguity

validators.name: APP_SEPARATION
validators.rule: app domain source/build independent from .ai-team/.amplai/host and obsolete legacy refs replaced safely
